method: Actual Playwright MCP interactions. Existing window maximized via Chromium window bounds, desktop viewport 1440x813. One context and one tab throughout recorded checks; normal logout/login for account changes. Temporary mobile viewports restored to desktop. No forced clicks, disabled-control overrides, fabricated network successes, or direct application database writes.

resolved_previous_findings.root_cause: Dashboard template hard-coded sample dollar figures and controller supplied no account data.
resolved_previous_findings.fix: Dashboard reads direct freelancer bookings and successful payments scoped to authenticated provider. Received payments deduct recorded refunds; failed payments, other providers, studio bookings, and deleted bookings are excluded. Labels describe all-time bookings, distinct clients, pending refunds, and payments received, not unsupported active-customer or revenue claims.
resolved_previous_findings.regression: New PHP tests failed before implementation, then passed for zero-data account, provider/type/status/deletion isolation, refunds, and removal of demo figures.
resolved_previous_findings.browser_actual: Lorena dashboard displays 4 bookings, 3 clients, 0 refunds pending, and ₱17,010.00 received. Independent normal UI comparison: active booking FS-BKF-00003 shows ₱1,260 paid; completed history shows paid totals ₱4,200, ₱7,350, and ₱4,200. Sum is ₱17,010.00. History clients Beatriz and Cristian plus active Daniela match 3 distinct clients.

resolved_previous_findings.fix: Owner booking location renders In-Studio for in-studio bookings. On-location addresses omit missing components and escape user-supplied text.
resolved_previous_findings.regression: Node test first reproduced N/A, N/A, Cavite instead of In-Studio. Three final cases pass: studio label, supplied on-location address, escaped venue markup.
resolved_previous_findings.browser_actual: Owner opened BK-6AE9F0AB26000 through its table action; Event Location displayed In-Studio.

resolved_previous_findings.fix: Booking form headings use theme-specific blue text; primary action uses darker blue for white-text contrast. Styling stays local to booking form.
resolved_previous_findings.regression: Saved Playwright check failed at 3.81:1 before CSS change. Dark heading now measures 8.4001:1 (#8ab8ff on #1b1c22); light heading measures 5.9063:1 (#2563b8 on white). Both exceed 4.5:1. Light/dark changed using visible theme-settings controls; original dark theme restored.
resolved_previous_findings.limitation: Measured heading pairing, not universal contrast certification for every component or theme skin.

resolved_previous_findings.fix: Booking form controls/buttons and checkbox-label areas receive 44px minimum height at mobile breakpoint. Visible focus outlines added and static field labels associated with inputs.
resolved_previous_findings.browser_actual: At 390x844, visible booking-form form-control, form-select, and btn elements are at least 44px tall. No horizontal page overflow at 320, 390, 768, 1024, or 1440px after responsive layout settles. Mobile-to-desktop sidebar transitions are awaited rather than treating transient geometry as settled layout. Keyboard Tab from Full Name reaches Contact Number with solid 3px focus outline.
resolved_previous_findings.limitation: Booking form scope only, not every portal control. No claim of real-device screen-keyboard or whole-site accessibility certification.

newly_found_and_fixed.root_cause: Package radios had inline display:none despite using Bootstrap btn-check, making every package absent from keyboard tab order.
newly_found_and_fixed.fix: Removed inline display:none. Existing visually hidden native radio styling remains; adjacent package label receives visible focus outline.
newly_found_and_fixed.regression: Actual Playwright Tab traversal failed to reach any package before fix. Saved browser regression reproduced this failure. After fix, Tab reaches a package radio and Space selects it without mouse or validation overrides.

tutorial_destinations.actual: Each of 13 visible tutorial links was clicked in its supported role and reached expected destination URL/title in same tab. Earlier content/Back/Next/Finish/replay evidence retained.

camera_server_validation.actual: Owner edited only explicit T14 test camera, entered whitespace for required name through normal field, then clicked Save. Server returned 422 with The name field is required. Feedback was role=alert, Save re-enabled, existing test camera remained. Form cleared afterward. No invalid changes persisted.
camera_server_validation.console_note: Expected 422 produces a browser resource error in this negative case; it is not an unhandled JavaScript exception.

additional_browser_checks.booking_invalid_submission: Proceed to Summary without event date produced Event Date Required / Please select an event date. No booking or payment was submitted.
additional_browser_checks.price_source_scan: No literal dollar-number, dollar-span sample metric, USD label, or PHP followed by numeric price remained in resources/views scan. This is source evidence only, not proof that every monetary value on every screen has been browser-verified.

Print-dialog receipt output was not exercised because one-window/one-tab constraint remains. Earlier payment and booking receipt values retain their passed evidence. Browser window itself was maximized and verified.

Full portal-by-portal price, error, permission, and accessibility coverage remains broader than this targeted pass. Camera whitespace rejection supplements earlier validation proof but does not cover every malicious/unauthorized input.
Real-device GPS uncertainty, exact mathematical 300m edge, screen readers, browser zoom, and on-screen mobile keyboard behavior remain unverified.
